title: AssetRef
description: A reference to a file stored with a project (an image, a font). The store chooses the id when the file is added; the file itself is read with ProjectStore.getAsset. A reference never changes: a stored asset is immutable.

name.description: The file's original name, for display. Not unique, and not how the asset is found.

mediaType.description: Lowercase media type, such as image/png. application/octet-stream when unknown.

size.description: Size of the original in bytes.

width.description: Pixel width of an image, when known.

height.description: Pixel height of an image, when known.

id.description: Letters, digits, - and _, starting with a letter or digit. Safe in a file name and in a URL.
